Hugh Capet.subject: World Geography

Over the very long term, Earth is currently in an icehouse period called the Late Cenozoic Ice Age, which started 34 million years ago. Iceland.fact: While early settlers cultivated barley, the cooling climate from the 12th century onwards made grain cultivation increasingly difficult. The Black Death reached Iceland in 1402–1404 and again in 1494–1495, with devastating effects. Iceland.fact: Iceland is generally included in Europe for geographical, historical, political, cultural, linguistic, and practical reasons.
